text:
Maria L.: hey team — PR #4831 ready for review. small import grouping + whitespace changes and one var rename. A few tests failing in CI though, not related? Please take a quick look when you have a second. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4831
CI Bot: ci/build — 2 tests failed on linux-integration: TestKVCacheTimeout, TestKVCacheEvict. logs: https://ci.redwood/reports/4831
Anil P.: looking now. if it's just whitespace + reorder i can approve. can you paste the import block that changed?
Maria L.: sure — snippet:
```go
import (
    "context"
    "fmt"

    "github.com/redwood-inference/runtime"
)
```
I also renamed `cfg` -> `config` in pkg/server/setup.go (small varcase change)
Sasha: code looks fine. Rename seems clean. about gofumpt — CI shows formatting diff? did you run `gofumpt -w`?
Maria L.: i ran gofumpt locally; pushed a fix. CI still failing on TestKVCacheTimeout, seems flakey. i don't think it's related to imports/rename. planning to re-run CI.
Chris B.: small nit — can we keep `runtime` import grouped with internal packages rather than stdlib? current ordering in snippet puts fmt after context which is fine, but runtime should be after fmt. Not a blocker though.
Anil P.: ack. happy to give approval once CI green. if flaky, we can force-merge after lgtm + sqa ok.
Sasha: i approve. :thumbsup:
Anil P.: lgtm
Maria L.: thanks — squashed and re-ran CI.
CI Bot: ci/build — all checks passed for PR #4831.
Maria L.: merging now.
CI Bot: merged PR #4831 into main.
